whatIsSuperheroWallet.question: What is Superhero Wallet?
whatIsSuperheroWallet.answer: Superhero Wallet is a **non-custodial open-source wallet** that allows users to manage crypto assets securely across **multiple blockchains**, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and æternity. Users maintain full control over their private keys and can interact with decentralized applications (dApps) and the Web3 ecosystem.

downloadAndInstall.question: How do I download and install the wallet?
downloadAndInstall.answer: You can download Superhero Wallet as a browser extension for Chrome and Firefox, or as a mobile app for Android and iOS. Simply visit the Superhero Wallet website and choose the version that suits your device.

supportedPlatforms.question: Which platforms support Superhero Wallet?
supportedPlatforms.answer: Superhero Wallet is available on desktop browsers (Chrome and Firefox extensions), as well as Android and iOS mobile devices. A web version is also accessible on desktop and mobile browsers.

setUpNewWallet.question: How do I set up a new wallet?
setUpNewWallet.answer: After installing the wallet, open the Superhero Wallet extension or app. Select “Create New Wallet,” and follow the prompts to set up a new wallet. Be sure to securely back up your seed phrase during this process.

importExistingWallet.question: How do I import an existing wallet?
importExistingWallet.answer: Open Superhero Wallet, select “Import Wallet,” and enter your seed phrase. This will restore your existing wallet, giving you access to previously stored assets.

backUpWallet.question: How do I back up my wallet?
backUpWallet.answer: When creating or importing a wallet, you’ll receive a seed phrase. Write this down and store it securely. The seed phrase is the only way to recover your wallet if you lose access.

dashboardDisplay.question: What is displayed on the Superhero Wallet?
dashboardDisplay.answer: The Dashboard is your main overview in Superhero Wallet. It shows your total crypto balance and how many tokens each account owns, individual account balances, quick action buttons (send, receive), and your recent transactions.

totalBalanceFiat.question: How can I see my total balance in fiat currency?
totalBalanceFiat.answer: Your total balance is displayed at the top of the Dashboard, reflecting the combined value of assets across all connected blockchains.

switchAccounts.question: How do I switch between accounts?
switchAccounts.answer: Scroll left or right on the active account card to view and switch between different accounts (e.g., Bitcoin, Ethereum, æternity). Each account displays its token balance and address.

multisigVaults.question: What are multisignature vaults, and how can I use them?
multisigVaults.answer: Multisignature (multisig) vaults require multiple accounts to approve transactions, offering enhanced security and control. You can toggle to view your multisig vaults on the Dashboard, currently available only on the æternity blockchain.

sendReceiveFunds.question: How do I send and receive funds?
sendReceiveFunds.answer: Use the “Send” button to transfer assets from your wallet to another address. The “Receive” button provides your wallet address and QR code to receive funds.

accountDetails.question: How do I view detailed information for each account?
accountDetails.answer: Click on any account card on the Dashboard to access the account overview page. Here, you’ll find account balance, current fiat value, account address, and the option to execute available actions like sending and receiving funds.

assetsTab.question: What does the ‘Assets’ tab show?
assetsTab.answer: The Assets tab lists all tokens stored in your account. Each token shows the quantity owned and, for assets with fiat value, the equivalent conversion.

transactionHistory.question: How do I check my transaction history?
transactionHistory.answer: The Transactions tab displays all past transactions for your selected account, including details like amount, transaction type, and time.

aens.question: What is the AENS (æternity Naming System)?
aens.answer: The AENS is a naming system on the æternity blockchain that allows users to register human-readable names for their wallet addresses, making interactions simpler.

shareAddress.question: How do I share or copy my wallet address?
shareAddress.answer: You can view a shortened version of your wallet address on the account overview page. Click the copy icon next to the address to easily share it with others.

nonCustodial.question: Is Superhero Wallet non-custodial?
nonCustodial.answer: Yes, Superhero Wallet is non-custodial, meaning only you have control over your private keys and assets. No third party, including Superhero, has access to your funds.

privateKeysManaged.question: How are my private keys managed?
privateKeysManaged.answer: Private keys are encrypted and stored securely on your device. You can view your private keys and back them up. The seed phrase is a master key that can restore all your accounts and their private keys. An optional password is used to encrypt the seed phrase in web applications; in the mobile apps the seed phrase is stored in secure storage and protected by biometric login.

forgotSeedPhrase.question: What should I do if I forgot my seed phrase?
forgotSeedPhrase.answer: Unfortunately, without your seed phrase, you cannot recover your wallet. We recommend securely backing it up when setting up the wallet.

airgapSetup.question: How can I set up AIRGAP for extra security?
airgapSetup.answer: Superhero Wallet supports AIRGAP, an offline signing method, to enhance security. Download the AIRGAP app and link it to Superhero Wallet for secure, offline transactions.

seedPhraseBackup.question: What is the seed phrase backup process?
seedPhraseBackup.answer: Your seed phrase is provided during wallet setup and also in settings. Store this phrase securely, as it’s the only way to recover your wallet if you lose access.

supportedDapps.question: Which dApps can I connect to with Superhero Wallet?
supportedDapps.answer: We currently support dApp integration for the ETH (via WalletConnect; EVM support coming soon) and AE blockchains.

walletConnect.question: How do I connect Superhero Wallet to dApps using WalletConnect?
walletConnect.answer: Select the WalletConnect option in Superhero Wallet and scan the dApp’s QR code. This enables connection to Ethereum dApps for a seamless Web3 experience.

inAppBrowser.question: How do I use the in-app browser on mobile for dApps?
inAppBrowser.answer: Open the Superhero Wallet mobile app and navigate to the In-App Browser section. Input the dApp URL, and connect directly to interact without leaving the app.

giftCards.title: Using Gift Cards and Invite Links

createSendGiftCard.question: How do I create and send a gift card?
createSendGiftCard.answer: In Wallet Settings, access the “Gift Cards” feature (currently available for æternity accounts only). Enter the amount you want to load onto the gift card, generate it, and share the unique invite link with new users. They can use it to redeem the gift card balance.

customizeGiftCards.question: Can gift cards be customized?
customizeGiftCards.answer: At present, you can specify the amount, but customization features are limited to this function.

forgotPassword.question: What should I do if I forgot my wallet password?
forgotPassword.answer: If you forget your password, the only way to access your wallet is by resetting it and using your seed phrase to restore your accounts. Ensure you’ve backed up your seed phrase and address book before resetting.

resetWallet.question: How do I reset my wallet?
resetWallet.answer: In Settings, select the “Reset Wallet” option. Note that this action will delete all local wallet data, so back up your seed phrase and address book beforehand.

delayedTransaction.question: Why is my transaction delayed?
delayedTransaction.answer: Delays can happen when the blockchain is congested. Transactions might not display immediately on the wallet but will appear once they’re processed and indexed.

dappConnection.question: Why can’t I connect to a dApp?
dappConnection.answer: Ensure that you’re using the latest version of Superhero Wallet. We provide EVM connectivity and WalletConnect for ETH dApps; AE uses its own method for dApp integration.

walletNotSyncing.question: What can I do if my wallet isn’t syncing?
walletNotSyncing.answer: Try upgrading the wallet to the latest version and make sure you have internet connectivity.

switchNetworks.question: How do I switch between mainnet and testnet?
switchNetworks.answer: Go to Settings, where you’ll see an option to toggle between mainnet, testnet, and custom networks. Select the network based on your needs.

manageMultipleAccounts.question: How do I manage multiple accounts?
manageMultipleAccounts.answer: You can create and manage multiple accounts within the same wallet by scrolling through the active account cards on the Dashboard.

exportAddressBook.question: Can I export my address book?
exportAddressBook.answer: Yes, you can export saved addresses in JSON format, which can then be imported into another Superhero Wallet.

customizeSettings.question: How do I customize notifications and settings?
customizeSettings.answer: Access the Settings menu to adjust notifications, customize profile preferences, and configure other wallet options.

githubRepository.question: Where can I find Superhero Wallet’s GitHub Repository?
githubRepository.answer: Visit Superhero Wallet GitHub for the repository, where you can view the source code, report issues, and request new features.

reportBugs.question: How do I report bugs or request features?
reportBugs.answer: Submit bug reports or feature requests directly through GitHub.

contactSupport.question: Who can I contact for support?
contactSupport.answer: For support, visit the Help Center on our website or submit bug reports directly through GitHub.

privacy.implicationsLi3: Any off-chain data voluntarily submitted (for example, support requests) will be processed in accordance with GDPR and relevant data protection laws.

privacy.supportP1: During the use of our Website, users may decide to contact the team in relation to website support, troubleshoot problems, questions, etc. The collection of personal data is initiated by Users, and they decide what type of personal data to include in the communication. Therefore, the legal basis for processing is that the User has given consent to the processing of their personal data for one or more specific purposes, specifically Article 6(1) of the General Data Protection Regulation (Regulation (EU) 2016/679). The retention period is until the questions have been answered, assistance from the team has been provided, the problems have been solved, or in any other case, until withdrawal of consent. Superhero.com may retain personal information for an additional period of time if it is required by law or for crime/breach/infringement prevention and safety.
privacy.rightsIntro: With regard to the information stored off-chain, if any, YOU have the right to:
privacy.rightsLi1: Request from Superhero.com access to the personal data that we hold about You in a portable format.
privacy.rightsLi2: Request from Superhero.com the correction of any collected personal data. The information may include only your personal data collection.
privacy.rightsLi3: Receive a copy of your personal data in electronic format.
privacy.rightsLi4: “The right to be forgotten” – You have the right to request the deletion of your personal data at any time where the retention of such data infringes relevant legislation.
privacy.rightsLi5: Receive information from Us about Our activities in connection to your personal data, including the purposes of collection and storage, the period of time for storage, the methods of collecting, and the presence of automated processing.
privacy.rightsLi6: Receive your data and transfer it to another controller.
privacy.rightsLi7: You have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority, in particular in the Member State of your habitual residence, place of work or place of the alleged infringement if You consider that there is a personal data breach.
privacy.sharingHeading: V. Sharing of Personal Information with Third Parties – Recipients
privacy.sharingP1: We may disclose USERS' identifiable personal information to third parties under special circumstances: (i) to comply with a legal requirement, judicial proceeding, court order, or legal process served on Superhero.com or its affiliates; (ii) to investigate a possible crime, such as fraud or identity theft; (iii) to Public Authorities in accordance with their legal obligation for the exercise of their official mission, such as tax and customs authorities, financial investigation units, independent administrative authorities, or financial market authorities responsible for supervision of securities markets; (iv) in connection with the sale, purchase, business transition under any form, merger, dissolution, reorganization, liquidation of Superhero.com (we may have to disclose the information You have given us to the successor who is part of the transition); (v) when We believe it is necessary to protect the rights, property, or safety of Superhero.com or other persons; or (vi) as otherwise required or permitted by law, including any contractual obligations of Superhero.com.
privacy.childrenP1: Superhero.com does not process information of persons under the age of obtaining full legal capacity (in most countries 18 years old) due to the character of the Website and the Wallet. Superhero.com will immediately delete any personal data referring to persons under the age of full legal capacity. We are not liable in any way if YOU provide false information about your age or use the Website before YOU have turned the above-mentioned age.
privacy.breachP1: In case of breach, We will undertake every possible action according to the applicable legislation in an appropriate and timely manner, to avoid any material or non-material damage to Users and to protect the personal data of Users.
privacy.contactHeading: VIII. How do I contact Superhero.com?
privacy.contactP1: To contact us with your questions or comments regarding this Policy or the information collection and dissemination practices of Superhero.com relevant to your use of the Website, please email us at superherowallet@protonmail.com.

explainer.title: How Bonding Curves Work
explainer.priceDiscoveryBody: Unlike traditional exchanges with order books, bonding curves use a mathematical formula to determine token prices. The price increases as more tokens are bought and decreases when tokens are sold. This creates automatic price discovery based on supply and demand.
explainer.formulaIntro: The bonding curve follows a quadratic formula:
explainer.supplyDescription: is the total number of tokens in circulation.
explainer.bullet1: Early buyers get tokens at lower prices
explainer.bullet2: Each purchase increases the price for the next buyer
explainer.bullet3: Selling tokens reduces the supply and lowers the price
explainer.bullet4: The curve ensures liquidity — you can always buy or sell
explainer.daoTreasuryBody: A portion of every transaction goes into a DAO treasury controlled by token holders. This treasury can fund community initiatives through on-chain governance votes, allowing the community to collectively decide how to grow and develop the token.
explainer.feesBody: When creating a token, you can set an initial buy amount. A small protocol fee (1%) is applied to support the platform and protocol token rewards. The rest goes into the bonding curve, ensuring fair price discovery from the start.

faq.heroTitle: Superhero — the all‑in‑one social + crypto app
faq.heroDescription: Discover trends, mint community tokens, trade on bonding curves, chat in real‑time, and govern treasuries — in partnership with Quali.chat.
faq.tip: Tip: Start with Getting Started, then explore Trendminer and DAO & Governance.
faq.gettingStartedIntro: New here? Here's the short version:
faq.gettingStartedLi1: Install Superhero Wallet and fund it with a little AE.
faq.gettingStartedLi2: Go to Trending and sort by Market Cap to explore tokens.
faq.gettingStartedLi3: Open a token, connect your wallet, and try a small Buy.
faq.gettingStartedLi4: Visit the DAO page to see treasury and proposals.
faq.featuresLi1: Trending lists with Market Cap default sorting
faq.featuresLi2: Token pages: chat, candlesticks, transactions, holders
faq.featuresLi3: Bonding curve trading (mint/burn) with DAO fee streaming
faq.featuresLi4: DAO pages: treasury, proposals, and voting
faq.featuresLi5: Governance: polls, delegations, and my account activity
faq.qWhatIsSuperheroAnswer: Superhero is a social + crypto app on the aeternity blockchain. You can discover content, create posts, tip, trade community tokens, and take part in on‑chain governance — all in one place.
faq.qChatPoweredByQualiAnswer: We partner with Quali.chat — a quality chat app for crypto people. Expect realtime conversations, moderation tools, and crypto‑friendly UX. Each token has a public room; holders can coordinate faster.
faq.qWhatIsTrendingAnswer: Trendminer lets you tokenize trending ideas. Creators launch community tokens on a bonding curve. Price adjusts with buys and sells; no order books, just math. A small fee flows into a token treasury (DAO) to fund community initiatives.
faq.qQuickStartTitle: Quick start: how do I begin?
faq.qQuickStartLi1: Install Superhero Wallet and fund it with a little AE.
faq.qQuickStartLi2: Open Trending and sort by Market Cap to see established communities.
faq.qQuickStartLi3: Tap a token, connect wallet, and buy a small amount to try it.
faq.qQuickStartLi4: Join the token's DAO and vote on proposals when available.
faq.qBuySellTitle: How do I buy or sell a token?
faq.qBuySellAnswer: On a token page, use the trade card. Choose Buy or Sell, review the live quote, and confirm in your wallet. Tokens are minted/burned against AE along the bonding curve.
faq.qFeesAnswer: A portion of each trade funds the token's DAO treasury. Holders can propose and vote to allocate funds for growth, bounties, or community rewards.
faq.qHoldersVsTxTitle: What are Holders and Transactions tabs?
faq.qHoldersVsTxAnswer: Holders shows top addresses and balances for the token. Transactions lists recent buys/sells with timestamps and transaction hashes.
faq.qDaoAnswer: Every token has a treasury. Anyone can create proposals. Holders vote on‑chain. If a proposal passes, the treasury can pay contributors or fund new ideas.
faq.qGovernanceAnswer: The Voting page provides a unified interface for browsing polls, voting, managing delegations, and viewing your on‑chain governance activity. All governance functions are accessible through tabs within a single page.
faq.qSocialAnswer: Yes. You can browse posts, comment, and explore communities. Comments and token chats are powered by Quali.chat — real‑time rooms built for crypto‑native communities.
faq.qAccountsTitle: What can I see on Accounts pages?
faq.qAccountsAnswer: Account profiles show owned tokens, created tokens, and activity. Leaderboards highlight the most active creators and traders.
faq.qRewardsProgramTitle: What is the Superhero Rewards Program?
faq.qRewardsProgramAnswer: The Superhero Rewards Program lets you earn AE tokens by completing milestones: verifying your X account, inviting new users, and posting about Superhero on social media. Complete milestones to unlock phases and earn up to 200 AE tokens.
faq.qRewardsMilestonesLi1: Verify X Account & Post — connect your X account and post to prove ownership.
faq.qRewardsMilestonesLi2: Link your X account to SuperheroID on-chain.
faq.qRewardsMilestonesLi3: Post about Superhero — publish 10 posts that include your referral link in the text.
faq.qRewardsClaimTitle: How do I claim my rewards?
faq.qRewardsClaimAnswer: Once a milestone is marked as completed, a claim banner appears on the Rewards page. Click the claim button and confirm the transaction in your wallet. A small gas fee applies.
faq.qRewardsEligibilityAnswer: Eligibility and rewards depend on on-chain activity and are not guaranteed. The program can be paused at any time without notice. Users from blacklisted countries are not eligible. By participating, you agree to the terms shown on the rewards page.
faq.qInvitesAnswer: The Trading Affiliate Program lets you create invite links funded with AE. When someone claims a link they receive the funded reward. Once 4 of your invitees each spend at least 10 AE in token sales, you can withdraw accumulated referral rewards.
faq.qAnalyticsTitle: How is Market Cap and pricing shown?
faq.qAnalyticsAnswer: We display price and market cap using AE as the unit. Trending defaults to Market Cap so larger communities surface first. Token pages include candlestick charts, recent transactions, and holders to help you read the market.
faq.qWalletAnswer: Use Superhero Wallet for aeternity. Install it, create or import your account, then connect on token pages to trade and participate.
faq.qRisksAnswer: Volatility and smart‑contract risk are real. Double‑check addresses and amounts before signing. Never risk funds you cannot afford to lose.
faq.qHelpTitle: Where do I get help or report bugs?
faq.qHelpAnswer: Reach out via official channels listed in the app. Include the token name, your address, the tx hash, and what happened.
faq.qSponsoredNameClaimTitle: What is a sponsored name claim?
faq.qSponsoredNameClaimAnswer: We sponsor one free .chain name claim per address. The name must be longer than 12 characters (excluding the .chain suffix). This gives you a human‑readable identity on the æternity blockchain at no cost.
faq.qClaimMoreNamesTitle: Can I claim more than one name?
faq.qClaimMoreNamesAnswer: We only sponsor one name claim per address. If you'd like to claim additional names, you can do so directly in Superhero Wallet — available as a browser extension, native mobile app, or on the web at wallet.superhero.com.
faq.qGlossaryTitle: Glossary: AE, sale address, DAO, tx hash
faq.qGlossaryLi1: AE: the native coin of the aeternity blockchain.
faq.qGlossaryLi2: Sale address: the contract that mints/burns tokens on the curve.
faq.qGlossaryLi3: DAO: on‑chain treasury + governance for a token community.
faq.qGlossaryLi4: Tx hash: the transaction ID; view in explorers to verify.

buyAe.pageDescription: Learn what AE is and the main ways to get AE for Superhero.
buyAe.heroTitle: Earn AE first, or buy it from external providers
buyAe.heroDescription: AE is the native coin of the aeternity blockchain. Use it to pay network fees, tip, trade trend tokens, and participate in on-chain activity on Superhero.
buyAe.tip: Availability and pairs can change. Always confirm details with the provider before sending funds.
buyAe.whatIsAeDescription: AE powers the aeternity blockchain. It is used for transaction fees, smart-contract interactions, tipping, and buying or selling community tokens on Superhero.
buyAe.earnSectionDescription: Start with Superhero-native ways to earn AE by growing the community and joining reward programs.
buyAe.buySectionDescription: Use third-party exchanges and swap providers when you prefer to purchase AE directly outside Superhero.
buyAe.gateDescription: Gate.io provides an AE/USDT market and is one of the main centralized exchange options for AE liquidity.
buyAe.changellyDescription: Changelly provides many AE pairs and is one of the best options for AE liquidity.
buyAe.swapzoneTitle: Swap ETH to AE on Swapzone
buyAe.swapzoneDescription: Use Swapzone to compare swap providers and exchange ETH to AE through the available route options.
buyAe.swapspaceTitle: Swap ETH to AE on SwapSpace
buyAe.swapspaceDescription: Use SwapSpace to exchange ETH for AE with direct routing options when available.
buyAe.bridgeTitle: Bridge or swap from other assets
buyAe.bridgeDescription: If you already hold crypto, use available Superhero DeFi tools or supported bridges and swaps to move value toward AE when routes are available.
buyAe.referDescription: Superhero invitations can help grow the network and unlock rewards when invitees become active. Use the invite page to create links and track rewards.
buyAe.xEarnDescription: A future earning path will reward activity from posting on X. This option is coming soon.
buyAe.safetyLi1: Confirm the token, network, deposit address, withdrawal fees, and minimum withdrawal amount.
buyAe.safetyLi2: Start with a small test transaction before moving larger amounts.
buyAe.safetyLi3: Keep custody in your own wallet when possible and never share private keys or seed phrases.
